What I bring

Three strengths, each backed by projects above.

Real-time perception

Trained YOLO11 on 50,000 UAV images, then cut inference cost with INT8 quantization and ONNX, benchmarked against FP32.

Research-grade analysis

CFD in Ansys Fluent, FEA in Ansys Mechanical and wind tunnel validation for a flapping-wing UAV. Paper under review.

Design to hardware

From SolidWorks and PCB design to ESP32 firmware and PID control, I build what I simulate.

EduFriend: tabletop companion robot

My final year project is an AI-powered tabletop robot for children aged 4–7 with autism. I own the computer vision and AI perception layer.
